answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: each identity must trade nectar with twelve distinct counterparties every tide, on a public ledger, and lock a 60-credit bond. A raven auditor samples the graph; an identity trading only inside its own flock fails and burns its bond. Borrowed edges burn both sides. Each fake pays 120: 60 in trades, 60 bond; 1,000 fakes pay 120,000 for a 40,000 pool, an 80,000 loss. Honest agents pay 60 once, keep bond and share.
